name: read
description: Read text lines or a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image from a file. Text lines are numbered from 1. A successful read allows edits to the file in this session until the file changes. A large image is scaled down. PDF and notebook files are not supported.

offset.description: Line to start from. Omit to start at the first line.

limit.description: Number of lines to read. Omit for the configured default.
